description:

complement the natural taste of black tea, without overpowering. The British East India Company
included Souchong teas as its common imports to colonial America. In the Boston Tea Party, 35 chests
of Souchong tea were destroyed.
subject: Tea History, Boston Tea Party
purpose: To provide tea enthusiasts with the opportunity to make and consume tea from the period of the American Revolution.
